response.sql: WITH per_actor AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), shares AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, CAST(film_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS share FROM per_actor) SELECT actor_id, film_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM shares ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films credited = count of film_actor rows per actor (the primary key is (actor_id, film_id), so there are no duplicates). Only actors with at least one credit appear, and the average is taken over those actors.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily because the request gives no tie-breaker.
